correctness.rationale: Every noncrossing matching has opposite-parity chords. The signed convolution diagonalizes on the finite binary edge group. Catalan parity recursion under reflection gives odd count precisely at Mersenne orders; then every signed sum is odd. At even orders reflection reverses the root-edge sign, giving a zero character. At odd non-Mersenne orders symmetrical lifting of a smaller zero leaves only central-root matchings, whose signed sum equals the square of the smaller zero. The recursion terminates, proving the all-n equivalence. Exact interval dynamic programming verifies explicit witnesses for n=1..30; full Walsh scans n<=4 corroborate counts.
